items.name: Xbox Series X|S Storage Expansion Card
items.why: The Series S has the smallest drive of the current consoles. An expansion card means you can keep GTA 6 installed alongside everything else.

items.name: HDMI capture card (1080p60 passthrough)
items.why: Kick is not a built-in Xbox broadcast target, so the console feeds a capture card and OBS on the PC does the streaming.

items.name: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Ti
items.why: Its NVENC encoder handles the stream encode on the PC, so the console runs the game and the GPU does the broadcast work.

items.name: USB streaming microphone
items.why: Clear voice matters more than video quality for small streams. A plug-and-play USB mic is the cheapest upgrade with the biggest payoff.

items.name: Wired gaming headset
items.why: Hear the game and chat without your mic picking up speaker audio.

items.name: High Speed HDMI 2.1 cables (x2)
items.why: One cable from the console into the capture card, one from the card's passthrough out to your TV or monitor.
